name: Espressif ESP32-S3
note: Thresholds and pullup live in mcu-pins.json (D-076). Enters with the datasheet version, section and page cited (M08-T04 step 6). No S3 module row is written: the corpus holds outlines only (BUCK engine.js lines 16 to 19, inferred) and no pad table.

value.note: held low with GPIO46 low selects joint download boot (Table 3-3)
selects the JTAG signal source; no internal pull, so the circuit must not leave it floating (section 3.4 p. 34)
sets VDD_SPI: low gives 3.3 V flash at the default eFuse (Table 3-4 p. 34)

provenance.source: Espressif ESP32-S3 Series Datasheet v2.2 (espressif.com esp32-s3_datasheet_en.pdf, sha256 2d5a7cb7fd559d8d972bd88db32669c0196d23f22d7afaafb0f63d099b589a3f, read 2026-10-09) section 3, Table 3-1 p. 32 (default configuration of strapping pins), Table 3-3 p. 33 (chip boot mode control), Table 3-4 and section 3.4 p. 34

value.activity: U0TXD: ROM messages print to UART0 at reset by default
U0RXD: an input at reset, not driven
